name: TollChat development
initializeCommand: if [ -n "${SSH_AUTH_SOCK:-}" ]; then echo 'SSH_AUTH_SOCK is set in the VS Code host process; fully quit VS Code and relaunch with SSH_AUTH_SOCK unset.' >&2; exit 1; fi
postCreateCommand: if [ -e .git ]; then :; elif [ -z "$(find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ]; then git clone https://github.com/rhprasad0/nova-toll-budget-agent.git .; else echo 'Workspace is non-empty and is not a Git checkout; preserving it unchanged.' >&2; exit 1; fi
